title: For each customer segment (SME, LAM, KAM) that has at least one EUR-paying
question: For each customer segment (SME, LAM, KAM) that has at least one EUR-paying customer with consumption recorded in June 2012, compute the percentage of those EUR-paying customers whose June 2012 consumption was below the segment’s average June 2012 consumption. Return the segment with the highest such percentage.

prediction.sql:
WITH June2012Consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."XCL_002" AS Segment,
        c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID,
        y."XCL_021" AS Consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c."XCL_001" = y."XCL_019"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND y."XCL_020" = '201206'
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers
    FROM June2012Consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
BelowAvgCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        j.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN j.Consumption < s.AvgConsumption THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BelowAvgCount,
        s.TotalCustomers
    FROM June2012Consumption j
    INNER JOIN SegmentStats s ON j.Segment = s.Segment
    GROUP BY j.Segment, s.TotalCustomers
)
SELECT 
    Segment
FROM BelowAvgCounts
WHERE TotalCustomers > 0
ORDER BY CAST(BelowAvgCount AS REAL) * 100 / TotalCustomers DESC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH June2012Consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c."XCL_002" AS Segment,
        c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID,
        y."XCL_021" AS Consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c."XCL_001" = y."XCL_019"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND y."XCL_020" = '201206'
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers
    FROM June2012Consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
BelowAvgCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        j.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN j.Consumption < s.AvgConsumption THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BelowAvgCount,
        s.TotalCustomers
    FROM June2012Consumption j
    INNER JOIN SegmentStats s ON j.Segment = s.Segment
    GROUP BY j.Segment, s.TotalCustomers
)
SELECT 
    Segment
FROM BelowAvgCounts
WHERE TotalCustomers > 0
ORDER BY CAST(BelowAvgCount AS REAL) * 100 / TotalCustomers DESC
LIMIT 1
